name: Vigilant Warden (sergeant)
revision: 0.1 · resin figure, command helm, comms pack and 32 mm base
description: The squad's sergeant (a Warden) directing the advance: left gauntlet thrown forward pointing the way, Spur sidearm raised at the shoulder, a cloth tabard hanging from the belt over the leading leg. Wears the command helm (crest blade and whip antenna) and the long-range comms pack.
buildNotes: Same Kestrel exosuit kit as the squad (tools/exosuit.py); this figure adds a pointing gauntlet (0.76 mm index finger), the Spur sidearm and a swept cloth tabard (0.84 mm thick).
Command helm: crest blade and a 0.84 mm whip antenna; the comms pack antenna is 0.84 mm with a 1.1 mm ball tip, both well inside the Formlabs wire table.
Integral 1.1 mm footplate keyed into the base recess; helm (1.6 mm) and backpack (2.0 mm) on D-flat pegs from miniature_base_and_peg.
Prints: figure tilted on supports at the angle miniature_support_plan picked; base flat on the plate.
limitations: Procedural sculpt, not a hand sculpt: smooth armour faces, simplified fingers. Printability is a heuristic screen through unified-CAD-MCP, not a test print; the STEP is a faceted reference.

scale.label: 30 mm heroic (about 32.5 mm to the visor crest)

mini.base: 25 mm round deck-plate base, 3.8 mm, 5 × 2 mm magnet pocket
mini.process: MSLA resin · 8K 7-inch class MSLA (e.g. Elegoo Saturn/Mars class)

printability.summary: base_and_peg: wall around the socket = 0.6 (limit 0.6); figure: minimum wall (supported) = 7.7069 (limit <= 0.5 mm2 thinner than 0.4 mm); helm: minimum wall (supported) = 5.8194 (limit <= 0.5 mm2 thinner than 0.4 mm); base: minimum wall (supported) = 5.0096 (limit <= 0.5 mm2 thinner than 0.4 mm)
